usedFor: Shopify is where products and customers live; Blog2Social shares to social networks. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Post” to publish a link, image or video on a connected account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in Blog2Social
bestTemplate.why: Launches get shared as a link, image or video post on a connected social account without you copying the details.

watchOut: “Create Post” publishes to a connected account, so it is public when it runs. “Order Cancelled” and “Abandoned Checkout” are poor post triggers; “Abandoned Checkout” is also polling.
